concept: Original scallop-shell cannon and lagoon pearl ammunition
authoring: Project-authored parametric scallop, tube, ring and pearl band meshes; Unity sphere primitive; existing URP Lit shader and project OFL font. No imported cannon or ball geometry.
integration: Presentation.asset references PearlCannon, PearlBall and PearlHit. CannonRigPreshoot triggers barrel recoil and shell squeeze; CannonExplodeParticle emits the muzzle ring. TXT_BallCount retains the existing counter binding.
dimensions: Cannon uses the existing 1.8 scale. Barrel centre is y=0.5004 and muzzle is z=-7.6 in world space; ball nominal radius is 0.5 before gameplay scaling. Collisions, speed, aim and damage logic are unchanged.

validation.assetGeneration: Batch build completed with exit code 0
checks: Deterministically sampled recoil and height preservation
validation.detailView: Same 60-degree game camera, zoomed with a display pearl placed beside the cannon. Ingame and shot images use the normal gameplay camera.
validation.scope: Editor PlayMode on Windows; mobile device performance was not measured. Existing arena, HUD, booster art and audio remain in use.
